name: Big Apple Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The fed's own top singles title, held through the last held BAWF broadcast by a wrestler whose own long-hidden family history became the story of the promotion's spring.

name: BAWF Television Championship
epitaph: A mid-card title already through multiple hands by the spring of 1998; the fed's own broadcasts separately bill two other wrestlers as former holders, with no date or order surviving for either reign.

name: BAWF Manhattan Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: A regional title first attested in the fed's own record by February 1998; the fed's own broadcasts separately bill its reigning Television Champion as a former holder, with no date surviving for that reign.

name: Big Apple Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The fed's own tag championship, defended in three-way and multi-team matches through the last held BAWF broadcast.
